Name: Cuter Jas - Seasonal and Festival Outfits
Description:
Hello!
This mod gives Jas a new look with outfits for all seasons and festivals. A face overlay option is also available if you would like to change only the face, it's compatible with both the vanilla game and Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfits Mod! This was my first time creating a mod with content patcher, so please let me know if you encounter any issues. I recommend using this along with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25033/]Cuter Vincent[/url] mod!


[b]Config options:
[/b]"CuterJas": "Seasonal_Clothes, Face_Overlay, Off"
[list]
[*] ﻿Choose Seasonal_Clothes if you want to use my seasonal outfits, Face_Overlay if you only want to use my face overlay, or Off to disable the mod.
[/list]
"WinterIndoorOutdoorOutfits": "IndoorOutdoor,IndoorOnly,OutdoorOnly"
[list]
[*] ﻿Choose IndoorOnly to only show the hatless winter outfit. OutdoorOnly to only show the winter outfit with the hat and scarf. IndoorOutdoor to use both.
[/list]
"FestivalOutfits": "True, False"
[list]
[*] ﻿Choose False if you don't want different outfits for each festival.
[/list]

[b]Credits:[/b]
This mod was inspired by Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfits Mod and uses sprites created by them with edits by me.
Original Portraits by ConcernedApe were edited by me with inspiration from Poltergeister's sprites and Ailin's portraits.
All new outfits were drawn by me.

Downloads.Description: Unzip file and place in mods folder. Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.
